About

I work at the intersection of the shopfloor and the dashboard — walking lines to catch where adherence breaks down, then building the Power BI and SQL systems that make those gaps visible and trackable. My path runs through Adani Wilmar's edible oils operations, then SKIL Global's consulting work on BakeMate's biscuit & confectionery lines — and since October 2026, in-house at BakeMate as Operational Excellence Executive, applying Lean Six Sigma, TPM, and structured RCA to close the loop between what the floor is doing and what the numbers say. Certified in Lean Six Sigma (Yellow Belt), Power BI, and SQL for data science, with hands-on exposure to HACCP, GMP, and safety compliance systems.
